lines.text: Many learners say: My brother is ten years.
Better: My brother is ten years old.
Say old after the number of years.
Ten years old! My sister is ten years old.

data.right: My brother is ten years old.
data.why: Say old after the number of years.

en.tip: Many learners stop at the years, but English adds old.
en.caption: Do you say this? “My brother is ten years.” 😅 The right way is “My brother is ten years old.” This is right because age needs old after years. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
